sample_unit: survey respondents (2020 National Survey on Drug Use and Health)

links.outcome: Reduction in subgroup performance bias after equality-of-odds mitigation, with overall accuracy and recall
links.effect: Bias fell by 21.66% (sex), 1.48% (race), 21.04% (income) with NN-SGD, and up to 41.62% (race) with NN-Adam. WMV classifier recall was 85.37% and 92.68%, accuracy 58.85% and 90.21%.
links.quote: Our bias mitigation algorithm substantially reduced bias with NN-SGD, by 21.66% for sex, 1.48% for race, and 21.04% for income, and with NN-Adam by 16.96% for sex, 8.87% for marital status, 8.45% for working condition, and 41.62% for race.

screen.reason: Evaluates the impact of an equality-of-odds algorithmic bias mitigation method on demographic disparities in an opioid use disorder predictive risk model.
